FeatureComp.heading: Features
FeatureComp.subheading: Make messaging changes in real time without rewriting code or waiting on deployments.

features.name: Instantly Switch Communication Channels
features.content:
Move between SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, or Voice without rebuilding systems.

ONE API makes messaging channel-agnostic so you can switch or add channels instantly without rewriting code or deploying updates.

  • Add new channels without separate API integration
  • Switch channels instantly during delivery issues
  • Route messages based on user behavior or preference
  • Enable multi-channel communication from one flow
  • Future-proof your messaging infrastructure

features.name: Update Message Templates in Real Time
features.content:
Modify message content across channels without code or deployment.

Update templates instantly across SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and RCS so business and operations teams can respond quickly.

  • Update templates instantly across all channels
  • Launch new messaging formats without delays
  • Run A/B testing for message optimization
  • Adapt quickly to compliance or policy changes
  • Reduce dependency on engineering teams

features.name: Ensure Delivery with Multi-Channel Fallback
features.content:
Automatically switch channels when message delivery fails.

If a primary channel fails, ONE API can trigger secondary or tertiary channels to ensure critical communication reaches the user.

  • Automatically switch between channels on failure
  • Increase delivery success rates significantly
  • Ensure reliability for critical alerts
  • Build fail-safe communication systems
  • Improve customer trust and experience

features.name: Improve OTP Delivery with Multi-Channel Routing
features.content:
Deliver OTPs reliably using intelligent channel selection.

Set SMS as primary and trigger WhatsApp, Email, or Voice fallbacks when needed to improve authentication reliability.

  • Send OTP via SMS with WhatsApp fallback
  • Add Email or Voice as backup channels
  • Improve authentication success rates
  • Reduce login and transaction failures
  • Enhance overall user experience

features.name: Enable Real-Time API Failure Alerts
features.content:
Notify teams instantly when systems or APIs fail.

Trigger alerts across SMS, WhatsApp, and Voice in parallel or sequence to reduce response time and downtime impact.

  • Send alerts across multiple channels instantly
  • Reduce response time for critical issues
  • Ensure alerts are never missed
  • Enable escalation workflows
  • Improve system reliability and uptime

features.name: Monitor Systems with Queue and Process Alerts
features.content:
Track system health with real-time queue notifications.

Set threshold and delay alerts across channels to improve visibility and prevent bottlenecks before they affect users.

  • Monitor queue delays and failures in real time
  • Trigger alerts instantly across channels
  • Improve system visibility and control
  • Prevent operational bottlenecks
  • Reduce downtime and performance issues

FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqsComp.subheading: Everything you need to know about running critical messaging on ONE API.

faqs.question: What is ONE API by MSG91?
faqs.answer: ONE API is a single API that lets you send messages across multiple channels through configurable flows. You define your channels, templates and fallback logic in MSG91, and your application makes one call. Channel changes then happen from the dashboard rather than in your code.

faqs.question: How is it different from integrating each channel API separately?
faqs.answer: With separate integrations, every new channel or routing change means new code, testing and deployment. With ONE API, you integrate once and manage channels, priority and fallback in a Flow, which saves engineering time and removes a common source of failure.

faqs.question: Which channels does ONE API support?
faqs.answer: SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice and Push Notifications.

faqs.question: How does multi-channel fallback work?
faqs.answer: You set a priority order in your Flow, for example, SMS first, then WhatsApp, then Voice. If the primary channel fails to deliver, ONE API automatically triggers the next one, so critical messages don't depend on a single route.

faqs.question: Can I change channels or templates without redeploying my code?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once your application is integrated with a Flow, you can switch channels, update templates and modify routing from the MSG91 dashboard without backend changes or a release. This includes A/B testing message content.

faqs.question: Can I use ONE API for OTP delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. A common setup is SMS as the primary channel with WhatsApp, Email or Voice as fallbacks. This raises the odds that users receive their OTP and complete login or payment on the first attempt.

faqs.question: Can I use it for internal alerts and system monitoring?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teams use ONE API to send API-failure, queue and threshold alerts across SMS, WhatsApp and Voice, in parallel or as an escalation chain, so incidents reach the right people quickly.

faqs.question: How do I get started, and how long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Create a Flow in your MSG91 dashboard: select the channel, name the Flow, choose a template and save. Voice Flows also need a caller ID. MSG91 then generates a sample JSON request you can drop into your application. Templates must be approved under each channel's rules first, such as DLT registration for SMS in India and Meta approval for WhatsApp.
